supersession.reason: Additive completeness remediation for T4B7-HIGH-003; prior claims remain immutable and this ledger adds every reachable source-backed mechanic and rendered/integration surface found in the bounded historical source.
supersession.scope_limit: Collector evidence only. No mapper, browser audit, review, truth test, candidate, acceptance, or manifest work was performed.

envelope_rule: Every text claim is one atomic proposition backed by an inclusive LF-terminated Git-blob range and whole-blob/range SHA-256. Historical source does not establish current runtime behavior.

claims.source_fact: The configuration defines player HP, arrow speed and fire rate, five formation columns, difficulty-specific row counts and enemy speeds, target-change intervals, scoring constants, and fixed layout coordinates.
claims.interpretation: Historical configuration inventory; not current balance or runtime proof.

claims.source_fact: getDifficultySettings returns player HP, row count, five columns, horizontal speed, and descent speed for the selected difficulty.
createEnemyFormation fills columns times rows with shuffled vocabulary, repeats vocabulary when needed, chooses a target in the bottom row, and assigns shieldUp true to every non-target enemy.

createArchersRevengeState rejects empty vocabulary and initializes playing status, difficulty HP, score/combo, wave one, target word/timer, actors, player position, fire timing, formation direction, elapsed time, and answer counters.
claims.interpretation: Historical initial-state surface; not a live start result.

claims.source_fact: fireArrow ignores non-playing state and shots inside the configured fire-rate interval, otherwise creates an upward arrow at the player lane and moves the player X to the shot coordinate.
claims.interpretation: Historical input/projectile rule only; no native input claim.

claims.source_fact: tickArchersRevenge advances game time, decrements the target timer, and when it expires selects a living enemy, updates targetWord, makes only that enemy shield-down, and resets the timer.

The tick moves the formation horizontally by difficulty speed and vertically by descent speed, reverses direction at horizontal bounds without moving that tick, and applies the movement to every enemy.
claims.interpretation: Historical movement and boundary rule only.

claims.source_fact: The historical tick returns defeat when the lowest formation boundary passes playerY minus 40.
claims.interpretation: Historical defeat guard only; not observed terminal reachability.

claims.source_fact: Arrows move by vertical velocity and are removed above the top edge; enemy projectiles move by vertical velocity and are removed below GAME_HEIGHT.

Arrow/enemy collision uses enemy dimensions; a shield-down hit destroys the enemy, awards score and combo, increments correctAnswers and totalAttempts, while a shield-up hit creates a downward retaliatory projectile, resets combo, and increments totalAttempts and wrongAnswers.
claims.interpretation: Historical collision and answer-accounting behavior only.

claims.source_fact: After a correct hit, an empty enemy list starts the next wave; otherwise a new living target is selected and only it becomes shield-down with the target timer reset.
Projectile/player collision uses a 40 by 40 player box, removes hit projectiles, decrements HP, resets combo, and marks defeat when HP reaches zero.
claims.interpretation: Historical health and defeat behavior only.

claims.source_fact: nextWave increments wave, creates a fresh formation and target word, resets the target timer, clears arrows and enemy projectiles, and resets formation direction.
calculateXP combines score, answer accuracy, elapsed-time speed bonus, and survival ratio, then clamps the result to 1 through 10.
The component start callback creates state with the selected difficulty, switches the phase to playing, and resets frame/reporting refs.
The component enters fullscreen during the playing phase and exits fullscreen in other phases.
The playing phase runs requestAnimationFrame ticks with delta time clamped to 50 milliseconds and changes to ended when state status is defeat.
claims.interpretation: Historical active-loop and defeat transition surface only.

claims.source_fact: The stage scale is the minimum of container width divided by GAME_WIDTH and container height divided by GAME_HEIGHT, defaulting to one before dimensions exist.
claims.interpretation: Historical composition scaling calculation only; not compact/wide observation.

claims.source_fact: The stage click/tap handler ignores non-playing phases, reads the pointer position, divides X by scale, and passes it to fireArrow.
claims.interpretation: Historical handler wiring only; no real-input evidence.

claims.source_fact: The start surface renders title/subtitle, three instructions, target-change tip, Shoot Tap/Click control, Draw Your Bow action, and easy/medium/hard difficulty buttons.
The playing surface renders a scaled Stage with background, target term and translation label, HP, score, and wave HUD values.
The playing surface renders enemy translation labels with shield-state styling, arrows, red enemy projectiles, the bow player marker, and target-timer progress.
The ended surface renders victory/defeat status, branch titles and subtitles, score, XP, accuracy, correct count, wave, time, health, restart, and exit actions.
claims.interpretation: Historical results surface only; reachability remains unknown.

claims.source_fact: The page fetches the Archer's Revenge vocabulary endpoint once and accepts the vocabulary into the store only when at least 15 words are returned; otherwise it renders an error state.
The completion callback stores XP and accuracy, then posts correct answers, attempts, accuracy, score, time taken, and difficulty to the Archer's Revenge completion endpoint.
claims.interpretation: Historical completion integration surface only; persistence success is not established.

negative_fixtures.proposed_claim: These mechanics prove the current Archer's Revenge route is runnable.
negative_fixtures.reason: All added envelopes are historical source evidence and do not prove current route existence or runnability.

negative_fixtures.proposed_claim: A shielded hit is wrong, retaliates, damages HP, resets combo, and ends the game.
negative_fixtures.reason: The proposition combines separate atoms and incorrectly asserts immediate terminal behavior.

negative_fixtures.proposed_claim: The scale calculation proves the game works in compact and wide viewports.
negative_fixtures.reason: A source scaling formula is not compact/wide live observation.

negative_fixtures.proposed_claim: The completion POST persists XP successfully.
negative_fixtures.reason: The envelope proves request construction only, not HTTP success or persistence.

coverage.absence_note: Not-present items are not promoted to claims; this package records only reachable source-backed atoms.
